name: COUPP
full_name: Chicagoland Observatory for Underground Particle Physics
summary: COUPP was a dark-matter programme using an iodine/fluorine liquid bubble chamber. It was tested at Fermilab and produced underground WIMP results at SNOLAB before merging with PICASSO to form PICO.
detection_principle: Nuclear-recoil energy deposition nucleates bubbles in superheated CF3I. Acoustic readout discriminates alpha backgrounds, and multiple bubbles help identify neutrons.

results.summary: Underground bubble-chamber data constrain spin-dependent and spin-independent dark-matter scattering.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
